_comment: Reviews shown on /  and /pricing. Written by the head dashboard (Reviews tab) via /api/reviews, which commits this file to GitHub; Vercel then redeploys and the change is live. Kept as a static file on purpose: the pages read it straight from the CDN, so a testimonial costs no database row, no API request and no runtime dependency. Edit by hand only if the dashboard is unavailable — keep the shape identical.
_provenance_rule: context MUST match reality. 'saw' = they were shown the product and have not run it. 'used' = they have actually used it. Nothing on the site may imply usage that did not happen. The card no longer prints this label - the section heading already frames these as first impressions shared with permission - but the answer is still recorded per review, because it is worth knowing before quoting someone.
